name: ns-derivation-out
description: An output frame's recording timestamp is the worker's, from the envelope, derived by truncation: 1789000000.999999999 s becomes sec 1789000000, usec 999999 — never rounded up into the next second. In a collected run, every output frame tapped from a data socket must appear in the session's recording with exactly this derivation of its own timestamp, which is what proves the core preserved the worker's clock instead of stamping arrival time.
